def titleize_sentence(sentence)
  # Define words that should remain lowercase
  lowercase_words = ['and', 'the', 'or', 'in', 'with', 'of']

  # Split the sentence into words
  words = sentence.split

  # Process each word
  titleized_words = words.map do |word|
    # Check if the word (in lowercase) is in the list of words to keep lowercase
    if lowercase_words.include?(word.downcase)
      word.downcase
    else
      # Capitalize the first letter and downcase the rest
      word.capitalize
    end
  end

  # Join the words back into a single string
  titleized_words.join(' ')
end
